hook: Embedding LaCl3 nanocrystals keeps a soft solid electrolyte from melting at 150 C.
hook_turn: keeps a soft solid electrolyte from melting at 150 C.
summary: Amorphous Li-Al-O-Cl electrolytes deform easily but melt when hot. Embedding rigid LaCl3 nanocrystals keeps the material solid at 150 C while conductivity stays above 1 mS per cm. Cells built with it ran stably at 80 C where the base material failed, though only lab-scale cells are described.
title: A Crystalline LaCl3 Reinforced Amorphous Oxyhalide Electrolyte for Thermally Stable All-Solid-State Batteries
venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society
